editorial: You never realize how the quiet moments of a lone home can become the storm you fear. The film strips away auditory clues, letting you feel the tension through breath and body language as the deaf heroine senses every treacherous heartbeat. Joaquin Phoenix delivers a subtle, unspoken performance that feels like a ghost whispering behind the walls. A slow handful of scenes drag, sapping the punch of the later revelations. You will be drawn in if you relish psychological thrillers that unsettle without shouting.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
